title: 第一卷 第2647章 凝练真理之剑第一卷 第2646章 掌握残剑
content_zh:
可惜，想要将一柄真我神器补充完毕，使其恢复到巅峰状态，显然并没有那么容易。林尘微微摇了摇头，心中闪过一丝遗憾，却也没有过多纠结。
如今光是残破状态下的诛仙残剑，就已经让他有一种所向无敌的感觉，若是有朝一日真能将其完全修复，他的战力会强横到何种地步，简直难以想象。不过修复诛仙残剑的事太过遥远，眼下也没工夫去考虑太多。对林尘来说，当前最重要的事情，还是将诛仙残剑当中所蕴含的剑意尽数吸收，夯实自己的剑道根基。
吸收了诸多剑意之后，林尘所凝聚出的真理之剑还在以极快的速度持续增加。每多出一把真理之剑，都意味着林尘的剑道实力往上攀升了一个巨大的层次。
十一把，十二把，十三把——整整十三把真理之剑悬浮在林尘周身，剑光流转，璀璨如星，每一把真理之剑都爆发出惊人的威力。感受着真理之剑散发出的恐怖威能，林尘的嘴角情不自禁地微微扬起。十三把真理之剑，别的不说，光是将其尽数召出，便已足够震慑群雄。
在逐渐掌握诛仙残剑的过程中，林尘却发现了一个问题。他敏锐地感知到，这座诛仙剑阵图似乎并不够完美，其中有几处关键节点的剑意流转颇为生涩，阵法结构也存在着明显的缺陷，整体的改良空间极大。念及至此，林尘眼中顿时绽放出一缕金光。俗话说得好，来都来了，如今他与李家已是密切合作的关系，帮李家完善一下诛仙剑阵图也未尝不可。日后若真有强敌攻入李家，这座被他完善之后的诛仙剑阵图也能发挥出更强的防御威能，于己于人都有好处。打定主意之后，林尘便不再犹豫，开始调动诛仙残剑中所蕴含的诸多剑意，着手推演补全这座古老阵图。
只见林尘挥动周身凝聚出的十三把真理之剑，每一把真理之剑皆是横空飞出，剑身上绽放出亿万道璀璨光华，耀眼夺目，将整座阵图核心都映照得如同白昼。十三把真理之剑如同在雕琢一件绝世艺术品一般，剑尖轻点虚空，一道道玄奥的剑意轨迹被刻画出来。在林尘的牵引与重塑之下，原本残缺不全的诛仙剑阵图开始一点点得到补充与修复。阵图各处原本生涩滞碍的节点逐渐被打通，剑意的流转变得顺畅而圆融。恢复过来的诛仙剑阵图散发出全新的威压，那股威压如同苏醒的远古巨兽，比之前明显提升了不止一个层次，沉甸甸地压在每个人心头。
身在诛仙剑阵图中的诸多剑修，此刻也都清晰感知到了剑阵图翻天覆地的变化。他们纷纷停下手中的参悟，齐齐将目光投向林尘，眼神中再度流露出难以掩饰的震撼。林尘不仅拔出了诛仙残剑，竟然还以一己之力完善了整座诛仙古剑阵。在剑阵被完善之后，阵图中大量释放出全新的剑意，这些剑意比之前更加完整、更加纯粹，对于身在阵中的每一个剑修而言，都是莫大的机缘。
众人纷纷沉下心神，吸收这些焕然一新的诛仙古剑阵所释放出的剑意。一时间，整座核心区域安静下来，只余下剑意流转的细微嗡鸣。所有身在其中的剑修都得到了不小的好处，他们身上散发出的气息与之前相比已是大不一样，剑意更加凝练，锋芒更加内敛。许多剑修再度看向林尘时，眼中已不单单是敬畏，更多了几分由衷的感激。若非林尘，他们根本不可能得到如此巨大的好处。
而那些之前追捧白子剑的人，此刻脸色都变得极为尴尬。他们簇拥在白子剑身边，本是指望这位凌霄剑门的圣子能带来什么惊人的机缘，带他们一飞冲天。可实际上，白子剑自己都没能在诛仙剑阵图中得到多少传承，他不过是勉强走到了核心位置，至于拔起诛仙残剑，更是连半点机会都没有。而林尘不仅做到了白子剑做不到的事，还顺手帮在场所有剑修都得到了好处。两相比较之下，他们追捧白子剑的举动简直成了一个笑话。
李家老祖李拐站在林尘身边，脸上早已堆满了狂喜的神色。林尘补全了残缺的诛仙剑阵图，这对他而言意义太过重大。多年以来，一直没有人能看出诛仙剑阵图的端倪所在，剑阵图的残缺始终是一个无人能解的谜题。因此李拐在阵图中枯坐多年，自身的剑道修为也迟迟没能取得突破性的进展。他之所以频频邀请光明圣城中的各大天骄前来一同参悟剑道，真正的目的就是希望借助各方天才的智慧，帮助他找出修复诛仙剑阵图的方法，将其彻底补全。如今林尘凭借自身所掌握的诸多强大剑意，一举完成了这个夙愿，李拐心中的激动与感激可想而知。阵图中的其他修行者眼中也都浮现出无限的仰慕之意，毫无疑问，林尘的所作所为赢得了在场所有剑修发自内心的敬意。
白子剑却依旧满脸不服，他站在人群中，脸色阴晴不定，终于忍不住沉声开口：“不过是运气好罢了。如果换成是我手握诛仙残剑，白白领悟了残剑中蕴含的诸多剑意，自然也能补全这诛仙剑阵图。”他的语气阴阳怪气，分明是在酸林尘的成就，试图为自己找回一点颜面。
白子剑话音刚落，林尘甚至还没来得及回应，在场的剑修中便有数人毫不客气地怼了回去。
“身为剑修，白子剑却毫无格局，自己实力就那样，还有脸瞧不起林公子。”
“白子剑，我很好奇，你哪来的勇气在这里羞辱林公子？要不是林公子为大家谋福利，你又如何能吸收到诛仙剑阵图中这完整无缺的剑意？”
“是啊，白子剑，我劝你不要太过分了。林公子是我辈剑修之楷模，侮辱林公子，瞧不起林公子，便是与我们在场所有剑修为敌！”
白子剑只说了那一句话，瞬间就被十几个剑修团团围住。那些剑修身上纷纷爆发出强悍的剑意波动，凌厉的锋芒在空气中交错碰撞，大有一言不合便要齐齐出手的架势。十几道剑意锁定之下，白子剑只觉遍体生寒，脊背都渗出了一层冷汗。
白子剑的心情变得无比郁闷，他怎么也没有想到，自己不过是说了几句酸话，就遭到众人这般围追堵截，简直不给他留丝毫脸面。这种被当众孤立的感觉让他心中愈发难受，像有一团火在胸口灼烧，却又无处发泄。
“可恶，真他娘的可恶！”白子剑低吼一声，眼底深处掠过一缕寒意。虽说他心中极为不服，拳头捏得关节发白，但终究还是忍住了没有动手。此刻林尘手握诛仙残剑，气息强横如龙，且深受在场诸多剑修的爱戴与拥护，若他现在跟林尘为敌，无异于自取灭亡，瞬间便会成为众矢之的。白子剑又不是傻子，就算再不甘心，也绝不会在这种时候做这种蠢事。
白子剑的心情郁闷到了极点。他万万没有想到，林尘竟能将诛仙剑阵图都给修复了，这等于是直接将整座剑阵图拔高了一个层次。那些原本只能停留在外围区域的散修们，本来来此一趟并不能得到太大的好处，可正因为林尘完善了剑阵，让他们即便身处外围，也能感知到诛仙剑阵图的强大，从中获取一些剑道领悟，使自身实力有所增益。林尘无形之中，已经成为了众多剑修眼中的英雄。谁若与林尘为敌，便是站在所有剑修的对立面。
白子剑识趣地闭上了嘴。凌霄剑门的其他天才剑修们也一个个脸色颇为难看，白子剑身为凌霄剑门圣子，他丢人现眼，连带着整个凌霄剑门也跟着颜面扫地。众人沉默着，气氛压抑得几乎凝固。

忽然间，李家老祖李拐高声宣布，声音洪亮而坚定，带着不容置疑的威仪：“现在请所有道友先行出去，我有一些事情要与林道友单独相谈。”
李拐语气笃定，显然已是下了逐客令。在场的这些剑修本就是受他邀请而来，此刻他要众人离开，自然有他的道理。以李拐的身份地位，只要他一句话，在场众人本不该有任何抗拒。听了李拐的话之后，绝大部分剑修都依言转身向外走去，唯独白子剑心中依旧有些不服气，脚步死死钉在原地没有挪动。
“前辈，我等也是受您邀请才前来诛仙剑阵图的，为何不让我们也在这剑阵图中继续参悟剑道？”白子剑当然不想离开，他好不容易才来到诛仙剑阵图的核心区域，按理来说完全可以留在这里参悟大量来自遥远时代的诛仙剑意。每一种杀伐剑意都能让他的剑道实力有所提升，他本身就是剑道天骄，身在这样的环境之中修炼，好处不言而喻。可李拐一句话便要将他同其他人一起驱逐出去，这让白子剑感觉自己极没面子。想到自己之前在林尘面前上蹿下跳，如同跳梁小丑一般，白子剑的嘴角便忍不住狠狠抽搐了几下，脸色也变得愈发凝重。
啪！
李拐根本没有跟白子剑多费口舌，直接一个大耳刮子便扇了过来。这一掌又快又狠，清脆的响声在寂静的核心区域中格外刺耳。白子剑猝不及防，整个人都被扇得往侧面踉跄了两步，死死捂住自己火辣辣发烫的脸颊，眼中满是不可置信的愤怒。他万万没有想到，李拐竟一言不合就直接动手。他好歹也是凌霄剑门的圣子，论身份地位绝对不差，可此刻李拐却对他丝毫不客气。要知道，凌霄剑门的底蕴与李家相比，那也是丝毫不差的。
只听李拐沉声说道：“你没听到老夫说的话吗？除了林公子之外，所有人都给我出去。”这话不是在跟白子剑商量，而是命令的口吻，每一个字都透着不容违抗的威严。白子剑心中更加难受，正犹豫间，李拐那蒲扇般的大手再度落下。连续两道清脆的耳光声响起，啪啪两声，白子剑整个人便如断线风筝般被抽飞出去，身形狼狈不堪地摔在地上，嘴角溢出一缕鲜血，跟他之前那副志得意满、目中无人的样子比起来，简直是判若两人。
白子剑心中彻底破防了，他万万没有想到李拐当真如此不客气。连续的巴掌打得他头昏耳鸣，心态碎了一地。不等白子剑自己爬起身离开，李拐便大袖一挥，一股磅礴的劲力直接将白子剑轰飞出去，连一点体面都没有给他留。
见状，围观的众多剑修纷纷发出爽朗的笑声。之前白子剑那般嚣张跋扈的态度早就惹了众怒，此刻看到他像条死狗一样被轰飞出去，众人心中都是忍不住一阵快意。
李家老祖李拐此刻已是毫无疑问地完全站在了林尘这一边。他转过身，布满皱纹的脸上浮现出一抹灿烂的笑容。林尘展现出的实力与天资，已然充分得到了李拐的认可，而李拐自己也从林尘手中得到了极大的好处。若非林尘，他怎么可能补全诛仙古阵图，了却心中多年夙愿？此刻李拐将所有人都驱逐出去，唯独留下林尘一人，是因为他手中有一份惊人的机缘造化要交到林尘手里。李拐看着林尘，嘴角的弧度又深了几分，那双阅尽沧桑的老眼中闪烁着意味深长的光芒。

content_en:
Unfortunately, it is obviously not that easy to replenish a true self artifact and restore it to its peak condition. Lin Chen shook his head slightly, a trace of regret flashed in his heart, but he didn't dwell too much on it.
Now, just the broken sword of Zhu Xian has given him a feeling of invincibility. If it can be completely repaired one day, it is simply unimaginable how powerful his combat power will be. However, repairing the broken sword of Zhu Xian is too far away, and there is no time to think too much about it now. For Lin Chen, the most important thing at the moment is to absorb all the sword intent contained in the Zhuxian Broken Sword and consolidate his foundation of swordsmanship.
After absorbing a lot of sword intent, the Sword of Truth condensed by Lin Chen continued to increase at an extremely fast speed. Each additional Sword of Truth means that Lin Chen's swordsmanship strength has risen to a huge level.
Eleven, twelve, thirteen - a total of thirteen swords of truth were suspended around Lin Chen. The sword light was flowing and shining like stars. Each sword of truth burst out with astonishing power. Feeling the terrifying power emanating from the Sword of Truth, Lin Chen couldn't help but raise the corners of his mouth slightly. The thirteen swords of truth, not to mention anything else, just summoning them all is enough to scare the heroes.
In the process of gradually mastering the Zhu Xian Broken Sword, Lin Chen discovered a problem. He keenly sensed that the Immortal Killing Sword Formation didn't seem to be perfect enough. The flow of sword intent at several key nodes was quite jerky, and the formation structure also had obvious flaws. The overall room for improvement was huge. Thinking of this, a ray of golden light suddenly bloomed in Lin Chen's eyes. As the saying goes, it's time to come. Now that he and the Li family have a close cooperative relationship, it's not a bad idea to help the Li family improve the Immortal Killing Sword Formation. If a powerful enemy attacks the Li family in the future, the Zhuxian Sword Formation that he has perfected will also be able to exert stronger defensive power, which will benefit both himself and others. After making up his mind, Lin Chen no longer hesitated and began to mobilize the many sword intentions contained in the Zhuxian's broken sword and began to deduce and complete this ancient formation.
Lin Chen was seen waving the thirteen swords of truth condensed around his body. Each sword of truth flew out across the sky, and billions of bright rays of light bloomed from the sword, which was so dazzling that it illuminated the core of the entire formation like daylight. The thirteen swords of truth are like carving a peerless work of art. The tip of the sword touches the void, and mysterious sword traces are carved out. Under Lin Chen's guidance and reshaping, the originally incomplete Zhuxian Sword Formation began to be supplemented and repaired bit by bit. The originally awkward and stagnant nodes in various parts of the formation were gradually opened up, and the flow of sword intent became smooth and harmonious. The restored Zhuxian Sword Formation exudes a brand new pressure. That pressure is like an ancient behemoth that has awakened. It has been significantly improved by more than one level than before, and it weighs heavily on everyone's heart.
Many sword cultivators who were in the Zhuxian Sword Formation clearly felt the earth-shaking changes in the sword formation at this moment. They all stopped what they were doing to comprehend and all looked at Lin Chen, their eyes showing unconcealable shock once again. Not only did Lin Chen pull out the Zhu Xian's Broken Sword, he also perfected the entire Zhu Xian Ancient Sword Formation by himself. After the sword formation was perfected, a large number of new sword intentions were released in the formation diagram. These sword intentions were more complete and purer than before, which was a great opportunity for every sword cultivator in the formation.
Everyone calmed down and absorbed the sword intent released by these brand-new Zhuxian Ancient Sword Formations. For a moment, the entire core area fell silent, leaving only the subtle hum of the sword's energy flowing. All the sword cultivators in it have benefited a lot. The aura exuding from them is completely different from before. The sword intention is more condensed and the edge is more restrained. When many sword cultivators looked at Lin Chen again, their eyes were not just filled with awe, but also with a bit of heartfelt emotion.Excited. If it weren't for Lin Chen, they would never have been able to obtain such huge benefits.
And those who had previously pursued Bai Zijian became extremely embarrassed at this moment. They gathered around Bai Zijian, hoping that the holy son of the Lingxiao Sword Sect would bring some amazing opportunities and take them to the sky. But in fact, Bai Zijian himself didn't get much inheritance in the Zhuxian Sword Formation. He just barely reached the core position. As for pulling out the Zhuxian Sword, he didn't even have the slightest chance. Lin Chen not only did what Bai Zijian couldn't do, but also benefited all the sword cultivators present. In comparison, their pursuit of Bai Zijian became a joke.
The ancestor of the Li family, Li Guai, stood beside Lin Chen, his face already full of ecstasy. Lin Chen completed the incomplete Zhuxian Sword Formation, which was of great significance to him. For many years, no one has been able to see the clues to the Zhuxian Sword Formation. The incompleteness of the sword formation has always been a mystery that no one can solve. Therefore, Li Guai had been sitting in the formation for many years, and his own swordsmanship had not been able to make breakthrough progress. The real purpose of why he frequently invites the geniuses in the Holy City of Light to come and learn swordsmanship together is to hope that with the wisdom of geniuses from all walks of life, he can help him find a way to repair the Immortal Killing Sword Formation and completely complete it. Now that Lin Chen has fulfilled this long-cherished wish in one fell swoop with the many powerful sword powers he has mastered, one can imagine the excitement and gratitude in Li Guai's heart. The eyes of other practitioners in the formation also showed infinite admiration. There is no doubt that Lin Chen's actions have won the heartfelt respect of all the sword practitioners present.
Bai Zijian was still dissatisfied. He stood in the crowd with a gloomy expression. He finally couldn't help but said in a deep voice: "It's just good luck. If it were me holding the Zhuxian Broken Sword, and comprehending the many sword intentions contained in the Broken Sword, I would naturally be able to complete the Zhuxian Sword Formation." His tone was sinister, and he was clearly criticizing Lin Chen's achievements, trying to regain some face for himself.
As soon as Bai Zijian finished speaking, before Lin Chen even had time to respond, several of the sword cultivators present responded unceremoniously.
"As a sword cultivator, Bai Zijian has no structure. His strength is just like that, and he still has the nerve to look down on Mr. Lin."
"Bai Zijian, I'm very curious, where did you get the courage to humiliate Mr. Lin here? If Mr. Lin hadn't worked for everyone's welfare, how could you have absorbed the complete sword intention in the Zhuxian Sword Formation?"
"Yes, Bai Zijian, I advise you not to go too far. Mr. Lin is a role model for sword cultivators of our generation. To insult Mr. Lin and look down on Mr. Lin is to make enemies of all the sword cultivators here!"
Bai Zijian only said that sentence and was instantly surrounded by more than a dozen sword cultivators. Those sword cultivators erupted with powerful sword intent fluctuations one after another, and the sharp edges collided in the air. They were ready to take action together if they disagreed. Under the locking of more than a dozen sword intentions, Bai Zijian felt cold all over his body, and a layer of cold sweat broke out on his back.
Bai Zijian's mood became extremely depressed. He never thought that he would be chased and intercepted by everyone just after saying a few harsh words, leaving him no face at all. This feeling of being isolated in public made him feel more and more uncomfortable, like a fire burning in his chest, but he had nowhere to vent.
"Damn it, so damn damn it!" Bai Zijian roared, a chill passing through his eyes. Although he was extremely dissatisfied and his fists clenched until his joints turned white, he still held back and did not take action. At this moment, Lin Chen was holding the Broken Immortal Sword in his hand. His aura was as powerful as a dragon, and he was deeply loved and supported by many sword cultivators present. If he were to become an enemy of Lin Chen now, it would be tantamount to self-destruction, and he would become the target of public criticism in an instant. Bai Zijian is not a fool. No matter how unwilling he is, he will never do such a stupid thing at this time.
Bai Zijian was extremely depressed.point. He never expected that Lin Chen could repair the entire Zhuxian Sword Formation, which was equivalent to directly raising the entire sword formation to a higher level. Those casual cultivators who could only stay in the peripheral area originally did not get much benefit from coming here, but because Lin Chen perfected the sword formation, they could feel the power of the Zhuxian Sword Formation even if they were in the periphery, and gained some swordsmanship insights from it, which improved their own strength. Lin Chen had unconsciously become a hero in the eyes of many sword cultivators. Anyone who is an enemy of Lin Chen is standing on the opposite side of all sword cultivators.
Bai Zijian closed his mouth knowingly. The other genius sword cultivators of the Lingxiao Sword Sect also had very ugly expressions on their faces. As the holy son of the Lingxiao Sword Sect, Bai Zijian was embarrassed, and the entire Lingxiao Sword Sect was also disgraced. Everyone was silent, and the atmosphere was so oppressive that it almost solidified.
Suddenly, Li Guai, the ancestor of the Li family, announced loudly, his voice was loud and firm, and he carried an unquestionable dignity: "Now please all fellow Taoists to go out first. I have some things to discuss with Fellow Taoist Lin alone."
Li Guai's tone was firm, and he had obviously given the order to expel the guests. The sword cultivators present were originally invited by him. Now he wants everyone to leave, which naturally has his reasons. Given Li Guai's status, as long as he said a word, everyone present should not have any resistance. After listening to Li Guai's words, most of the sword cultivators turned around and walked out. Only Bai Zijian was still a little unconvinced, and his steps were firmly fixed in place and did not move.
"Senior, we were invited by you to come to the Zhuxian Sword Formation. Why don't we also continue to learn the swordsmanship in this Sword Formation?" Bai Zijian certainly didn't want to leave. Every killing sword intention can improve his swordsmanship. He is a genius in swordsmanship. The benefits of practicing in such an environment are self-evident. But Li Guai wanted to expel him and the others with just one word, which made Bai Zijian feel extremely humiliated. Snap!
Li Guai didn't waste any time talking to Bai Zijian, and just slapped him with a big ear-scratcher. This palm was fast and hard, and the clear sound was particularly harsh in the silent core area. The strength and talent displayed by Lin Chen have been fully recognized by Li Guai, and Li Guai himself has also benefited greatly from Lin Chen.
